LIST (THE MINIMUM t IN (Customer c [has CustomerSegment: 'SME'] [has CustomerCurrency: 'CZK'] AND ALSO THE SUM OF v IN c is of Yearmonth [has YearmonthDate d] has YearmonthConsumption v WHERE d >= '201301' AND d <= '201312' GROUPED BY c AS t)) - (THE MINIMUM t IN (Customer c [has CustomerSegment: 'LAM'] [has CustomerCurrency: 'CZK'] AND ALSO THE SUM OF v IN c is of Yearmonth [has YearmonthDate d] has YearmonthConsumption v WHERE d >= '201301' AND d <= '201312' GROUPED BY c AS t)), (THE MINIMUM t IN (Customer c [has CustomerSegment: 'LAM'] [has CustomerCurrency: 'CZK'] AND ALSO THE SUM OF v IN c is of Yearmonth [has YearmonthDate d] has YearmonthConsumption v WHERE d >= '201301' AND d <= '201312' GROUPED BY c AS t)) - (THE MINIMUM t IN (Customer c [has CustomerSegment: 'KAM'] [has CustomerCurrency: 'CZK'] AND ALSO THE SUM OF v IN c is of Yearmonth [has YearmonthDate d] has YearmonthConsumption v WHERE d >= '201301' AND d <= '201312' GROUPED BY c AS t)), (THE MINIMUM t IN (Customer c [has CustomerSegment: 'KAM'] [has CustomerCurrency: 'CZK'] AND ALSO THE SUM OF v IN c is of Yearmonth [has YearmonthDate d] has YearmonthConsumption v WHERE d >= '201301' AND d <= '201312' GROUPED BY c AS t)) - (THE MINIMUM t IN (Customer c [has CustomerSegment: 'SME'] [has CustomerCurrency: 'CZK'] AND ALSO THE SUM OF v IN c is of Yearmonth [has YearmonthDate d] has YearmonthConsumption v WHERE d >= '201301' AND d <= '201312' GROUPED BY c AS t))
note: The evidence's formula (sum of the lowest-consumption customers' totals divided by how many tie for lowest) is mathematically equal to the MIN of per-customer 2013 CZK totals within each segment, since tied customers all share that same total. Query returns the three pairwise differences (SME-LAM, LAM-KAM, KAM-SME) side by side in one row.

LIST c FROM DISTINCT Transactions1k has Transactions1kDate d AND ALSO has Gasstation has GasstationCountry c WHERE year(d) = 2013 AND month(d) = 6
note: This model's only date reachable from Gasstation is Transactions1kDate, which in this database contains only four values, all in August 2012 (checked with a DISTINCT listing). The evidence describes a YYYYMM date format ('201306', first 4 chars = year) that matches Yearmonth's date instead, but Yearmonth connects only to Customer, not to Gasstation/Transactions1k, so there is no path from that YYYYMM-formatted June-2013 data to a gas station's country. The query above is the best-faith literal reading (transactions joined to their gas station's country, filtered to year 2013 month 6); it compiles and runs correctly but returns 0 rows because no Transactions1k row in this dataset falls in June 2013 -- a data-coverage gap, not a modeling one.
